data.animaCaption: Freezing mid-reach with a wooden spatula as a frying pan and cracked egg hover above the stove in faint violet sparks, she glances sheepishly toward you in the doorway. Crisp morning sunlight streams through the kitchen window across the steam and her floral linen apron.
data.promptProse: Framed across a tidy wooden breakfast counter in the foreground, Ayachi Nene is caught red-handed during a minor magic mishap in a sunlit morning kitchen. Wearing a floral linen cross-back apron over an ivory puff-sleeve cotton blouse and grey midi skirt, she reaches up with a spatula in wide-eyed panic as a cast-iron frying pan and a hovering fried egg float midair above the stove surrounded by faint violet sparkles. Bright early-morning sunlight slices diagonally through the window blinds, illuminating curls of kettle steam and turning her silver ahoge bright white.
data.story: 推开厨房门时，一只平底锅正冒着淡紫色微光稳稳悬在燃气灶半空。宁宁举着木铲慌慌张张想把它按下来，见你已经看见全过程，整张脸瞬间红透——「不、不是偷懒！我只是想让煎蛋翻面漂亮一点……刚才那段请全部忘掉！」
